reason: I'm home with the baby all week and I'm always looking for somewhere indoors, especially when it's cold or hot. The gated Baby Nook and the limit on how many kids are in at once is what would get me through the door, and the free first visit lets me check it out. I'd come maybe twice a month, because the zoo is free and $13 adds up fast on our budget.
objection: Will the bigger kids be running wild around my baby, even with a Baby Nook? And $13 a visit when the zoo costs nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing in person on the free visit that the Baby Nook is actually separate and calm. A lower price for a weekday morning would also help.
